newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish Sept trade surplus FIM 3.0 billion-customs.
newsitem.headline: Finnish Sept trade surplus FIM 3.0 billion-customs.

text.p: Finland's trade surplus fell to 3.02 billion markka in September from 3.47 billion in August, the National Customs Board (NCB) said in a statement on Tuesday.
The value of exports fell four percent year-on-year in September while the value of imports rose eight percent, NCB said.
The Bank of Finland earlier estimated the September trade surplus at 3.7 billion markka with exports seen at 15.0 billion and imports at 11.3 billion.
The NCB's official monthly trade statistics are lagging behind due to changes in customs procedures when Finland joined the European Union at the start of 1995.
